startups.name: Joylicious Joy
startups.description: Joylicious Joy in Every Bite Pvt. Ltd. is a women-led food innovation startup focused on developing science-backed functional foods that improve women's health through nutrition. Founded in 2025, the company combines food technology, nutrition, and research to create convenient, clinically relevant products for different life stages, including postpartum recovery, iron deficiency, PCOS, and menopause. Its flagship innovation is the Postpartum Recovery Cookie Cup, designed using nutrient-dense ingredients to support maternal recovery. Alongside research and product development, Joylicious also operates a premium dessert brand, serving both retail and B2B clients. The company aims to bridge the gap between healthcare and everyday nutrition by creating evidence-based food solutions that are accessible, delicious, and impactful while promoting women's well-being and generating employment opportunities.

startups.name: KRISHARTHH PRIVATE LIMITED
startups.description:
KRISHARTHH Private Limited is an agritech startup dedicated to empowering farmers through innovative, affordable, and accessible agricultural solutions. Our mission is to bridge the gap between farmers, agricultural businesses, technology, and markets through a comprehensive digital and on-ground platform.

KRISHARTHH provides a wide range of agricultural services, including quality seed supply, organic biofertilizers, vermicompost, soil testing, expert agricultural advisory, farmer produce procurement, and doorstep delivery of agricultural inputs and services. Our platform also facilitates farmer-to-farmer and farmer-to-consumer connectivity, helping farmers access essential resources, connect with buyers, and explore better market opportunities. By integrating technology with field-level support, we aim to make agricultural services more convenient, transparent, reliable, and affordable, particularly for small and marginal farmers.

Our commitment to agricultural innovation extends to AquaProbe, an AI-enabled, IoT-based smart irrigation intelligence solution designed to monitor soil moisture, temperature, humidity, and crop stress. The portable probe integrates crop type, growth stage, and weather conditions to generate irrigation recommendations, including when irrigation is needed, how much water should be applied, and how long irrigation pumps should operate. It can also help farmers determine whether irrigation can be postponed based on expected weather conditions. With voice-based assistance, AquaProbe aims to communicate essential farm insights directly to farmers, supporting informed decisions, efficient water use, and improved crop management.

KRISHARTHH strives to promote sustainable farming, strengthen agricultural supply chains, and improve farmers' access to technology and markets. Through continuous innovation and farmer-centric solutions, we envision building an integrated agricultural ecosystem that supports productivity, resource efficiency, and long-term rural development.

programs.title: Inclusive Technology Business Incubator (i-TBI)
programs.description: A prestigious flagship initiative supported by the Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India, specifically engineered to catalyze innovation and technology-driven startups within educational institutions across a robust 3-year support framework.
benefits: Seed grant support up to ₹10 Lakhs per eligible prototype
Dedicated co-working and lab prototyping access
Technical mentorship from university and industrial researchers
Assistance with patent filing, IP valuation, and commercialization
programs.eligibility: Early-stage technology founders, student innovators, and alumni developing AI/ML, IoT, electronics, or wearable hardware.

programs.title: MSME Incubation Scheme
programs.description: Administered in partnership with the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME), this program fosters grassroots innovation and empowers emerging enterprises with seed capital, business modeling, and market access.
benefits: Government grant support for proof-of-concept validation
Access to MSME procurement networks and vendor portals
Comprehensive regulatory, GST, and corporate compliance guidance
Subsidized testing and quality certification support
programs.eligibility: Micro and small enterprises, student founders, and commercial prototypes with high potential for job creation.

programs.title: Start in UP Program
programs.description: The Uttar Pradesh Government's flagship startup initiative empowering entrepreneurs with state-level fiscal incentives, seed capital, marketing allowances, and institutional validation.
benefits: Monthly sustenance allowance for eligible founders
State-level regulatory sandboxes and preferential procurement
Showcase opportunities at UP Global Investors Summit
Direct linkages with regional angel and venture capital networks
programs.eligibility: Startups registered with Start in UP and DPIIT operating in Uttar Pradesh.

programs.title: PSIT Innovation Hub & Idea Lab
programs.description: Supported by AICTE IDEA Lab, this cross-disciplinary laboratory encourages students to apply science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) fundamentals through hands-on fabrication and rapid prototyping.
benefits: Access to 3D printers, CNC machining, laser cutters, and electronics workstations
Skill-enhancement bootcamps on IoT, robotics, and embedded firmware
Pre-incubation mentoring and patent clinic guidance
programs.eligibility: All undergraduate, postgraduate students, research scholars, and faculty innovators.

team.name: shri Pranveer Singh
team.bio: Visionary founder and Chairman of PSIT Kanpur, dedicated to transforming engineering and management education into centers of global excellence.
team.quote: At PSIT, we are committed to nurturing confident, capable professionals through industry-aligned education, innovation, research, and collaboration. With dedicated faculty, hands-on mentorship, and exposure to emerging technologies, we empower students to pursue meaningful careers, higher studies, and entrepreneurship. Our vision is to transform bright minds into leaders who shape tomorrow.

team.name: Prof.(Dr.) Man Mohan Shukla
team.bio: Eminent academician and administrator guiding the holistic institutional development, industry partnerships, and accreditation across PSIT institutions.
team.quote: At PSIT, we embrace technological advancement and innovative learning to prepare students for a rapidly evolving world. Through expert faculty, industry-oriented education, practical exposure, and holistic development, we nurture skilled professionals and future leaders. Our commitment to academic excellence, teamwork, and strong industry partnerships empowers students to achieve success.

team.name: Prof.(Dr.) Raghvendra Singh
team.bio: Distinguished researcher and academic leader spearheading research excellence, curriculum modernizations, and innovation culture.
team.quote: At PSIT, we strive to create an environment where academic excellence, innovation, and holistic development go hand in hand. Through dedicated faculty, industry collaboration, research opportunities, and value-based education, we empower students to become responsible professionals, creative thinkers, and future leaders equipped to make meaningful contributions to society.

team.name: Prof.(Dr.) Raghuraj Singh Suryavanshi
team.bio: Visionary leader with a deep commitment to fostering innovation, entrepreneurship, and problem-solving. Under his leadership, the Startup Cell has evolved into a dynamic incubator supporting startups from ideation and prototyping to venture funding.
team.quote: Our mission is to bake innovation into the DNA of every student, turning potential into world-changing startups.

team.name: Mr. Anurag Dhawan
team.bio: Leading executive operations, startup acceleration, DST compliance, and strategic investor relationships at PSIT Startup & Incubation Foundation.
team.quote: Bridging the critical gap between student innovations and commercial venture capital.

team.name: Dr. Nand Kishore Sharma
team.bio: Guiding research initiatives, advanced computing laboratories, and technical mentorship for student software ventures.

team.name: Dr. Rajat Verma
team.bio: Championing artificial intelligence research, algorithm design, and hackathon incubation.

team.name: Mr. Deepak Gupta
team.bio: Mentoring systems architecture, cloud infrastructure, and student engineering development teams.

team.name: Mr. Sandeep Kumar Khare
team.bio: Managing technical laboratories, hardware prototyping facilities, and software development testing for incubated ventures.
